# Timeline Preview (v0.2.1)

## Purpose
Provide deterministic operator inspection of unified WaveForge timeline alignment before rendering.

## Generated file
- timeline_preview.html

## What preview shows
- packet metadata and prompt
- PHI369 constants
- coherence pass/fail
- 3 acts / 6 scenes / 9 sync events
- audio sections
- visual scenes/shots
- phi cut points
- receipt hashes

## Limitations
Preview is static HTML and deterministic; it is not real media playback or rendered video.

## Future path
Evolve toward PhiOS visual operator dashboard with richer local controls and governance overlays.
